title: Southern California ARML
text:
The Southern California ARML team and Long Beach Math Circle meets periodically during the school year on weekends on the campus of California State University, Long Beach.

For more information see CSULB Math Dept. web page.

Unfortunately, Kent Merryfield, who used to coach this team, passed away in 2018. As a result, for more information, please contact Dr. Olga Korosteleva at olga.korosteleva@csulb.edu.

-Edited by smartninja2000
